title: An Evaluation of Hybrid Annotation Workflows on High-Ambiguity Spatiotemporal Video Footage

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating whether AI-generated video segment pre-annotations induce a passive anchoring bias (or 'semantic drift') in human annotators. This is measured by comparing the alignment of individual annotation sessions, both with and without AI assistance, against a Consensus Baseline using Adjusted Mutual Information (AMI), as well as evaluating structural coherence via latent-space Silhouette Scores.
